info.name: Atlassian List All Repository Permissions for a Workspace

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

params.name: q
params.description:
Query string to narrow down the response as per
[filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#filtering).

params.name: sort
params.description:
Name of a response property sort the result by as per
[filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#sorting-query-results).

items.docs: This GET operation retrieves a comprehensive list of all repository permissions configured within a specific Bitbucket workspace. By targeting the /workspaces/{workspace}/permissions/repositories endpoint, it returns permission details for repositories in the specified workspace, allowing administrators and authorized users to audit access controls and understand who has what level of access (read, write, admin) to repositories.
